sources.title: Implement data security and compliance with SQL
sources.shortSummary: The secure learning path directly lists this module, which links the encryption, masking, RLS, permissions, auditing, AI-service access and API-security units.

sources.title: Optimize database performance
sources.shortSummary: The path links this performance module and its configuration, isolation, plans, Query Store, blocking and summary units.

sources.title: Implement CI/CD by using SQL database projects
sources.shortSummary: The path lists this module with separate build, reference-data, branching, drift, pipeline and testing units.

sources.title: Integrate SQL solutions with Azure services
sources.shortSummary: The path links this module covering DAB configuration, entities, objects, hosting, monitoring and change-driven integration.

sources.title: Protect data with encryption
sources.shortSummary: Distinguishes storage encryption, client-side Always Encrypted and explicit SQL symmetric-key encryption; shows opening a certificate-protected key before ENCRYPTBYKEY and DECRYPTBYKEY.

sources.title: Configure dynamic data masking
sources.shortSummary: Introduces output masking and SQL Server 2022 granular UNMASK; directly references the product masking article and warns about ad hoc inference.

sources.title: Implement row-level security
sources.shortSummary: Explains inline table-valued security predicates, enabled policies, row visibility and write blocking; directly references the RLS product article.

sources.title: Manage permissions and secure access
sources.shortSummary: Provides GRANT/REVOKE/DENY examples, role access, Entra and managed-identity connections, effective-permission inspection, and client secret/certificate handling relevant to database deployment identities.

sources.title: Implement auditing
sources.shortSummary: Distinguishes an audit destination from selected actions and links SQL Server Audit and Azure SQL auditing implementation articles.

sources.title: Configure secure access to AI services
sources.shortSummary: Introduces controlled access to model endpoints and directly references database-scoped credentials and sp_invoke_external_rest_endpoint.

sources.title: Secure data API endpoints
sources.shortSummary: Separates authentication, authorization, network controls and per-operation access for REST, GraphQL and MCP; explicitly advises allowlists instead of malicious-pattern blocklists.

sources.title: Always Encrypted
sources.shortSummary: Without enclaves, deterministic encryption supports equality operations while randomized encryption does not support searching; client drivers encrypt parameters and keys remain outside the engine in plaintext form.

sources.title: Encrypt a Column of Data
sources.shortSummary: Shows AES symmetric keys protected by certificates, binary ciphertext storage, and opening the key before SQL encryption/decryption, with optional matching authenticators.

sources.title: Dynamic data masking
sources.shortSummary: SELECT and UNMASK have separate roles; SQL Server 2022 supports column-scoped UNMASK. Output masking leaves underlying values intact, and masked SELECT INTO/export output can become statically masked copies.

sources.title: Row-level security
sources.shortSummary: Separates FILTER and operation-specific BLOCK predicates and explains how policy SCHEMABINDING controls permission checks on predicate functions and lookup tables.

sources.title: GRANT (Transact-SQL)
sources.shortSummary: Defines WITH GRANT OPTION and shows a role member using AS role to delegate that role's grant option; AS records the grantor rather than generally granting impersonation.

sources.title: Microsoft Entra authentication for Azure SQL
sources.shortSummary: Azure SQL Entra authentication requires an Entra administrator, matching SQL principals and client tokens; Azure SQL Contributor management roles do not supply database data access.

sources.title: Auditing for Azure SQL Database and Azure Synapse Analytics
sources.shortSummary: Documents Azure SQL audit destinations, availability-oriented recording, current server-audit master-folder layout, and failed Entra authentication being recorded by Entra before database access.

sources.title: SQL Server Audit (Database Engine)
sources.shortSummary: Describes binary file targets and filesystem permissions: service and audit administrators need appropriate read/write access, readers need read access, and archived copies can remove database-service access.

sources.title: CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL (Transact-SQL)
sources.shortSummary: Database-scoped credentials store external-resource authentication information and have database-scoped creation permissions and master-key protection requirements.

sources.title: sys.sp_invoke_external_rest_endpoint (Transact-SQL)
sources.shortSummary: Defines EXECUTE ANY EXTERNAL ENDPOINT, REFERENCES on a named credential, URL/path credential matching, and Azure SQL primary user-assigned versus system-assigned managed identity selection.

sources.title: Recommend database configurations
sources.shortSummary: Explains service/compute tier selection and configuration levers including compiled plan stubs for single-use ad hoc workloads, MAXDOP, compatibility level and automatic tuning.

sources.title: Preserve data integrity with transaction isolation levels and concurrency controls
sources.shortSummary: Contrasts statement-level RCSI with transaction-level SNAPSHOT and locking isolation; identifies update conflicts and short transaction boundaries.

sources.title: Evaluate query performance with execution plans and DMVs
sources.shortSummary: Distinguishes actual runtime plans from estimates, cached-query DMVs from active requests, and diagnostic evidence such as cardinality mismatches, lookup costs and spills.

sources.title: Monitor and tune queries with query store and query performance insight
sources.shortSummary: Provides execution-count-weighted Query Store duration aggregation, persisted plan comparisons, query-level hints, wait statistics and Query Performance Insight's dependency on Query Store.

sources.title: Identify and resolve blocking and deadlocks
sources.shortSummary: Explains blocking chains, sleeping uncommitted sessions, writer conflicts under RCSI, deadlock graphs and application transaction recovery.

sources.title: Summary
sources.shortSummary: The inspected Learn-more list directly references the vCore tier article, transaction guide, Query Store article and deadlocks guide used for this domain.

sources.title: Transaction locking and row versioning guide
sources.shortSummary: Defines row-version selection per statement or transaction, Sch-S/Sch-M interactions, and SNAPSHOT termination when a concurrently committed update invalidates a write.

sources.title: Monitor performance by using the Query Store
sources.shortSummary: Persists multiple query plans and time-bucketed runtime/wait statistics; supports retrospective plan comparisons and plan forcing without application text changes.

sources.title: Deadlocks guide
sources.shortSummary: Error 1205 terminates the victim transaction and requires safe retry of the unit of work; consistent object access order and short transactions reduce circular lock dependencies.

sources.title: vCore purchasing model - Azure SQL Database
sources.shortSummary: The current vCore comparison distinguishes 4-TB General Purpose/Business Critical limits from 128-TB Hyperscale and continuously provisioned versus demand-scaled compute.

sources.title: Create, build, and validate SQL database projects
sources.shortSummary: Introduces declarative object definitions, .dacpac compilation, target-platform validation and SqlPackage Publish/Script/DeployReport for new or existing databases.

sources.title: Configure source control and manage reference data
sources.shortSummary: Versions schema sources and reference-data scripts while excluding generated outputs; SQLCMD includes combine scripts and Build Remove excludes them from model compilation.

sources.title: Manage branching, pull requests, and conflict resolution
sources.shortSummary: Uses short-lived feature branches, reviewed object-level diffs, PR build validation and rebuilding after merges because a clean text merge can leave unresolved schema references.

sources.title: Detect and resolve schema drift
sources.shortSummary: Describes directional schema comparison, selective hotfix import, saved .scmp configuration, extraction and nonexecuting Script/DeployReport artifacts.

sources.title: Implement CI/CD pipelines
sources.shortSummary: Separates build artifacts from deployment stages, describes secret injection and federated OIDC identity, and distinguishes branch review/build controls from production environment approvals.

sources.title: Design and implement a testing strategy
sources.shortSummary: Differentiates model build validation, focused SQL unit tests and deployed end-to-end integration tests, with pre/test/post actions and scalar, row-count and schema conditions.

sources.title: Summary
sources.shortSummary: Directly links SQL project, pre/post deployment, comparison, automation and Azure Repos branch-policy documentation used for the domain.

sources.title: What are SQL database projects?
sources.shortSummary: Defines model validation and dependency-aware deployment, GA VS Code Microsoft.Build.Sql SDK projects, cross-platform .NET builds and the .NET Framework exception for SQLCLR project builds.

sources.title: Pre-deployment and post-deployment scripts overview
sources.shortSummary: Pre/post scripts are packaged but not compiled or validated in the database object model. The deployment plan is calculated before pre-deployment executes; post-deployment follows plan execution.

sources.title: Compare a database and a project
sources.shortSummary: Explains source-to-target schema comparison, selective database-to-project import, deploy-report XML and SqlPackage Script as separate nonexecuting review artifacts.

sources.title: Schema comparison overview
sources.shortSummary: Comparison actions make a target match a source; .scmp stores source/target information, comparison options and excluded object types, and differences can be selectively excluded.

sources.title: About branches and branch policies
sources.shortSummary: Azure Repos documents minimum reviewers, comment resolution, build validation, status checks and path-related automatically included reviewers as distinct branch policies.

sources.title: SQL projects automation
sources.shortSummary: Documents build-once artifact flow, target deployment review, environment gates, and self-hosted runners for databases isolated from public networks.

sources.title: Create configuration files for data API builder
sources.shortSummary: Defines configuration responsibilities for $schema, data-source, runtime and entities, identity transmission through session context, environment-variable references and matching a schema to the installed DAB version.

sources.title: Define entities for REST and GraphQL
sources.shortSummary: Explains entity aliases, REST/GraphQL routes, field filtering, cursor pagination and relationship cardinality.

sources.title: Expose database objects, stored procedures, and views
sources.shortSummary: Describes explicitly keyed views, stored-procedure entities, procedure authorization or session-context controls for shared database connections, and one/many GraphQL relationships.

sources.title: Explore deployment options for data API builder
sources.shortSummary: Shows DAB container deployment, configuration packaging, runtime secret injection and distinct process-response versus data-access health probes.

sources.title: Recommend Azure monitor configurations
sources.shortSummary: Relates request, dependency and exception telemetry to API diagnosis; discusses correlated traces, container logs, latency/error indicators and alerting.

sources.title: Handle changes with event-driven patterns
sources.shortSummary: Directly references CDC, Change Tracking and CES product documentation and contrasts retained values with current-state synchronization and streaming.

sources.title: Summary
sources.shortSummary: Supplies direct training links to the DAB configuration reference, Container Apps deployment guide, CDC and Application Insights.

sources.title: Stored procedures in the REST API
sources.shortSummary: DAB stored-procedure REST uses execute permission, GET query parameters or POST JSON, defaults to POST, returns the first result set only, and supplies no parameter-level authorization.

sources.title: Data API builder configuration schema reference
sources.shortSummary: Current DAB schema reference separates data-source, runtime and entity settings and documents version-specific schemas, multiple configuration files and startup secret references.

sources.title: Data API builder CLI reference
sources.shortSummary: Current DAB CLI reference names init, add, configure, update, start and validate responsibilities and links their exact command entries.

sources.title: Implement level 1 cache
sources.shortSummary: DAB 2.0 L1 caching is in-memory, requires global and entity opt-in, operates per REST route/parameter, and does not apply to GraphQL endpoints.

sources.title: Deploy Data API builder to Azure Container Apps
sources.shortSummary: Packages dab-config.json in a custom image at the runtime path and supplies DATABASE_CONNECTION_STRING through deployment environment settings; requires a reachable supported database.

sources.title: Introduction to Application Insights - OpenTelemetry observability
sources.shortSummary: Defines Application Insights application-performance monitoring and its transaction, failure, performance, availability and correlated component views; telemetry collection requires applicable instrumentation.

sources.title: Overview of Log Analytics in Azure Monitor
sources.shortSummary: Log Analytics queries Azure Monitor Logs; resource entry points scope records to that resource, while a workspace entry point supports workspace-wide investigation within granted permissions.

sources.title: What is change data capture (CDC)?
sources.shortSummary: SQL Server/Managed Instance CDC captures log-derived row values into retained relational change tables, with separate all/net-change functions and transaction metadata.

sources.title: About Change Tracking (SQL Server)
sources.shortSummary: Change Tracking records changed keys and operation metadata within the transaction, while applications read current row values; it does not retain every intermediate row image.

sources.title: What is change event streaming (preview)?
sources.shortSummary: CES remains Preview and streams DML CloudEvents to Event Hubs or Fabric Eventstream. Managed Instance requires SQL Server 2025 or Always-up-to-date policy; SQL Server 2025 Entra support starts with CU3 on Arc/Azure VM.
